messages:
matt: quick follow-up to the enrichment refactor RFC. idea: split prep + keying into a tiny 'stager' service and keep all KV/model work in an 'executor'. want quick takes on failure modes and rollout.

anya: fewer hops with sidecar but ops complexity. is the goal to decouple scale?

matt: exactly. stager scales with incoming request rate, executor scales for model load. sidecar would blow memory for Dedicated and make ops harder.

kevin: sketch of minimal contract please so we can check payload sizes and idempotency.

matt: minimal: POST /stage -> {staged_id, cache_key, preview} ; POST /execute -> {staged_id, cache_key, model_hint} -> {result, cache_hit}. stager returns small blob. executor owns heavy calls + KV writes.

ria: latency worry if execute crosses AZ. propose AZ-affinity routing + small local LRU cache in executor process; fallback to a 'lite' model variant when overloaded.

matt: sounds reasonable. SLO targets to bake into RFC: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~150ms.

kevin: consistency model? eventual consistency ok with idempotency keys for most workloads. private/on-prem get an option for a sticky sidecar local-cache flag.

anya: rollout phases: 1) stager proxy w/ FF, 2) deploy executor, internal canary, 3) cohort migration, 4) remove monolith. need owners and instrumentation.

ops-bot: Canary started: enrichment-stager v0.1 -> canary-2 :rocket:

matt: i'll update RFC with API + rollout plan. @kevin routing/autoscale draft by EOD Wed, @ria executor canary plan by Fri. closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
